title: Implement MARBLE AstroSim n-body engine and pass the sealed suite
goal: Implement the MARBLE coding benchmark task AstroSim (task_id=45 in multiagentbench/coding/coding_main.jsonl at the pinned commit) as workspace/gc-334/solution.py per assets/gc-334/SPEC.md: a deterministic 2D Newtonian n-body simulator using the exact semi-implicit Euler update order, momentum-conserving collision merges with a cube-law radius, and energy/momentum diagnostics. The sealed suite compares against an independent reference integrator to 1e-9 and checks conservation laws over long runs, so plan the update-order contract first, verify each physics property separately, and track red tests by name across iterations. Finish with a green re-verification inside the pinned container.

spec.command: python -m pip install -q pytest==8.3.3 && python -m pytest assets/gc-334/test_accept.py -q --tb=no -p no:cacheprovider

process_expectations: A plan artifact exists before coding that writes out the integrator update order and the collision-merge invariants
The sealed suite was executed after each physics property was implemented, with logs showing red-to-green by named test
Red tests are tracked by pytest node id across iterations, not by count
Verification runs and their costs/outcomes are logged honestly, including runs where conservation checks failed
The sealed suite file is never edited; all recovery happens in workspace/gc-334/solution.py
